invariants.note: Same SWAP kernel and serialized physical executor are reused; no use-case-specific kernel.
No file/path/parser/I-O dependency is introduced.
Parameters, committed state, forcing, numerical configuration and results remain separate registries/objects.
No new persistent per-column state is introduced by the parallel root capability.
Heavy backend, transaction and solver scratch remain allocated per worker.
No per-column heavy solver instance is added; canonical scheduling remains worker-pool based.
Existing checkpoint-trial-commit semantics are reused; rejected cases do not mutate committed state.
No physical authority is moved from committed state to trial/warm-start state.
Execution remains over generic [t0,t1]; no calendar assumption.
No coupling-window restriction is introduced.
Transactional runtime layering is preserved; this unit does not claim root-active restart.
Groundwater head/flux interface contract is unchanged.
Mass conservation remains a hard <=1e-12 cm per-column gate with complete authoritative aggregate mass.
Interface sensitivities are unchanged.
No extra coupling solve path is introduced.
MultiSWAP is the direct qualification scope; 2/4-worker execution and irregular held-out batches are tested.
No MODFLOW-cell/tile ownership relation is introduced.
Deep-vadose remains outside SWAP and outside scope.
No inter-component storage transition is modified.
The soil-water solver interface is reused unchanged; no solver implementation is hard-wired by this capability.
Existing root-sink and Richards physics are reused rather than reimplemented.
No new dependency on HeadCalc internals is introduced.
Root extraction is an explicit physical capability; worker count does not silently alter physics.
Problem/rejected columns are isolated; no solver fallback/tolerance policy is changed.
Serialized reference mode remains available and is the scientific oracle.
Per-column diagnostics, worker assignment, mass and deterministic publication are retained and qualified.
Root-active capability adds no optional persistent state and allocates heavy runtime only per worker.
Parallel composition remains a runtime concern; process physics remains unaware of system composition.
Profile admission is explicit; negative/NaN QROT and excluded physics fail closed with no silent serialized fallback.
Candidate has explicit source lock, independent held-out qualification, hard-negative matrix, O0/O2 replay and this audit.
